intro: This collection showcases our data-driven initiatives that transform how we address global challenges. The portfolio evolves continuously as we develop new approaches to data collection, cleaning, analysis, visualization, and AI implementation. Each project represents our commitment to harnessing data science for advancing UNESCO's mission. From monitoring critical global indicators to creating interactive visualizations that make complex information accessible, these tools empower decision-makers with evidence-based insights. Our work spans traditional statistical analysis to cutting-edge machine learning applications. We're constantly exploring innovative ways to collect, process, and present data that drives meaningful action. As technology advances, so does our portfolio. New projects emerge while existing ones evolve, ensuring we remain at the forefront of using data to address the world's most pressing challenges.

description.p: This Observatory provides updated information on the killing of journalists since 1993 and on the judicial status of condemned cases since 2006. It also provides public access to country responses to UNESCO's requests for information into the judicial status of ongoing and unresolved cases. You may browse the full list of killed journalists and search for visual statistics and data.

description.p: This tool has been designed to facilitate research in the Administrative Manual and related circulars, and other UNESCO Sources. It guarantees a high level of accuracy by citing the chapter and page from which the information was extracted, allowing you to cross-reference and verify the information at its original source.

description.p: HerAtlas serves as an interactive world map, employing a color-coded scoring system to monitor 12 key indicators of legal progress toward gender equality in education. From constitutional guarantees of education without sex-based discrimination to setting a minimum marriage age of 18, the tool scrutinizes important legal aspects. HerAtlas simplifies complex legal language, making it accessible across diverse contexts and enhancing public awareness of the unalienable right to education for every individual.

fig.label: Key indicators of legal progress toward gender equality in education

description.p: A Power BI dashboard solution to visualize, analyze, and monitor the UNESCO Creative Cities Network data. This interactive platform will:

ul: Track key performance indicators across the 7 creative fields (Crafts & Folk Art, Design, Film, Gastronomy, Literature, Media Arts, and Music)
Monitor cultural initiatives, collaborative projects, and events

description.p: The dashboard will support data-driven decision making for network management, facilitate knowledge sharing between cities, and highlight successful initiatives that can be scaled across the network.

fig.label: Creative fields tracked across the Creative Cities Network

description.p: As part of the Global Education Coalition (GEC), the Global Skills Academy (GSA) is committed to empowering youth by enhancing employability skills and supporting their transition into the labor market. In line with Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 4, UNESCO is launching the Skills for the Future: Business Commitment for Youth Empowerment initiative. The goal of this project is to design and implement a data-driven dashboard to monitor the impact of business commitments on youth empowerment. The dashboard will ensure alignment with SDG 4 and other related targets by providing a centralized, visual tool to track and report on progress.

fig.label: Business commitments for youth empowerment, monitored in one dashboard

It enables users to explore projects by country, region, thematic area and other key dimensions, with interactive maps, indicators and project-level information.

Interactive data visualization developed to explore and analyze the results of the Youth for Peace initiative. The platform organizes survey responses into key indicators and thematic clusters, making it possible to identify common patterns, priorities and perspectives among participating youth.

Interactive platform designed to map and explore expertise across UNESCO’s network. It brings together profiles, thematic areas and geographic information to help identify relevant expertise, visualize connections and support knowledge sharing across teams and regions.
